short_description: A squat followed by a sweeping roundhouse kick that trains the legs, glutes, and hip mobility together.
how_to: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat, keeping your chest up.
Stand up and shift your weight onto your left foot.
Drive your right leg in a wide circular arc at hip height.
Return to your stance and squat again before switching sides.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes in the squat.
Keep your heels down as you lower.
Keep your core braced during the kick.
Keep your standing leg slightly bent for balance.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't drop too fast into the squat.
Don't kick beyond your comfortable range.
Don't lean back to swing the leg higher.

short_description: A jump-rope simulation that builds cardiovascular fitness and coordination without any equipment.
how_to: Stand tall with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Begin bouncing lightly on the balls of your feet.
Rotate your wrists in small circles as if turning a rope.
Keep a steady, low-impact rhythm.
Breathe evenly and maintain an upright posture.
correct: Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your core lightly engaged.
Keep your jumps small and controlled.
mistakes: Don't land hard on flat feet.
Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't tense your shoulders up near your ears.
Don't hold your breath.

short_description: A wide-grip push-up variation with feet elevated that targets the chest, shoulders, and triceps.
how_to: Start in a push-up position with your hands wider than your shoulders.
Bring your feet close together and point your knees outward like a frog.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Press back up to the start position.
Repeat for the target reps.
correct: Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Keep your elbows controlled on the way down.
Keep your core engaged throughout.
Lower at a steady pace.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't rush the descent.
Don't let your lower back sag.

short_description: A plank hold with jumping-jack leg hops that challenges core stability and raises your heart rate.
how_to: Start in a forearm plank with your body in a straight line.
Keep your core braced and your hips level.
Jump both feet out wide, then back together.
Maintain the plank position throughout.
Repeat at a steady pace.
correct: Keep your body in one line.
Keep your core engaged.
Land softly on each hop.
Keep your knees over your toes.
mistakes: Don't let your lower back sag.
Don't lift your hips too high.
Don't land hard.
Don't let your knees cave inward.

short_description: A step-up exercise using a sturdy chair that strengthens the quads, glutes, and hamstrings.
how_to: Stand facing a sturdy chair with your feet together.
Place your right foot fully on the seat.
Press through your right heel to step up and stand tall on the chair.
Step back down with control, leading with your left foot.
Alternate your leading foot each rep or complete one side at a time.
correct: Keep your chest tall and your back straight.
Press through your heel as you step up.
Keep your knee aligned over your foot.
Lower yourself down with control.
mistakes: Don't use momentum to bounce up.
Don't lean your torso too far forward.
Don't let your knee wobble inward.
Don't step down with a loud impact.

short_description: A push-up with hands placed wider than shoulder-width to emphasize the chest and front shoulder.
how_to: Place your hands wider than your shoulders with your fingers pointing forward.
Extend your legs behind you in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to the start.
Repeat for the target reps.
correct: Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Keep your elbows controlled on the way down.
Keep your core tight throughout.
Lower your chest all the way to near the floor.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't let your lower back sag.
Don't shrug your shoulders up.

short_description: A seated ab exercise that pulls the knees in and extends them out to work the core and hip flexors.
how_to: Sit on the floor with your hands behind you for support.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet off the floor.
Draw your knees in toward your chest.
Extend your legs straight out without touching the floor.
Repeat in a smooth, controlled rhythm.
correct: Keep your core braced throughout.
Keep your lower back from rounding excessively.
Move at a steady, controlled pace.
Breathe out as you draw your knees in.
mistakes: Don't let your feet drop to the floor between reps.
Don't collapse your chest forward.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't rush and lose control of your legs.

short_description: A supine stretch that draws one or both knees into the chest to release the lower back and hips.
how_to: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended.
Draw one or both knees toward your chest.
Wrap your hands around your shins or the backs of your thighs.
Gently pull until you feel a comfortable stretch in your lower back.
Hold and breathe steadily, then release.
correct: Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Keep your hold gentle and steady.
Breathe slowly and fully.
Relax your hips into the floor.
mistakes: Don't force the stretch beyond a comfortable range.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't pull sharply or with a jerk.
Don't tense your neck and shoulders.

short_description: A full-arm plank hold that builds core, shoulder, and back stability.
how_to: Place your hands directly under your shoulders with your arms straight.
Extend your legs behind you so your body forms a straight line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Maintain the line from head to heels for the target time.
correct: Keep your body in one line.
Keep your core engaged.
Keep your wrists stacked under your shoulders.
Breathe steadily throughout the hold.
mistakes: Don't let your lower back sag.
Don't lift your hips too high.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't let your head drop or crane upward.

short_description: A twisting crunch that brings the opposite knee and elbow together to target the obliques and rectus abdominis.
how_to: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Rotate your right elbow toward your left knee as you draw the knee in.
Return to center, then rotate your left elbow toward your right knee.
Alternate sides with control.
correct: Keep your lower back controlled.
Keep your elbows wide, not pulled forward.
Rotate from your torso, not just your neck.
Move at a deliberate, controlled pace.
mistakes: Don't arch your lower back.
Don't pull on your neck.
Don't rush through the rotation.
Don't let your shoulders drop fully between reps.
